prompt: Which interstate war has had the highest estimated number of combat deaths since World War II?
answer: The **Korean War (1950–1953)** had the highest estimated combat-death toll among interstate wars since World War II, with roughly **2.6–4.1 million combat deaths**. Estimates vary depending on whether civilian deaths and deaths from famine or disease are included.
